{{Top|leg}}
'''Poll''' was the name of the [[Winter/Legends|cold]] season on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Draenell's Point]], preventing the growing of the majority of [[Foodstuff/Legends|crops]]. A local [[Standard year/Legends|year]] on Draenell's Point lasted 4.2 standard years, and Poll spanned around fourteen [[Standard month/Legends|standard months]], accounting for a quarter of Draenell's Point's [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] cycle.
